title: C.E. 2471.031 — the first shot is a certification refusal
notes: Episode 01. Noah's ore ship is held at the Earth gate: the cargo is ore and a child's marrow therapy, and the ship's identity is suspended rather than its cargo seized. The scene's legal fact is why that works at all — no instrument in the register reaches who counts as a person, so classifying someone out is not prohibited by anything. LEX returns UNGOVERNED, and silence is the finding rather than a permission.
